title: Save a new contact
aliases: how do i add a contact
add someone to my address book

steps.instruction: Type the person's first name in "First name".
Type the person's last name in "Last name", if you know it.
Tap the tick icon to save the contact.

source_note: Contacts on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Start from the contacts list, not a contact card or the lists screen. First name, Last name, add phone and Phone capitalisation need device confirmation. The save control may be a tick icon or Done depending on the layout. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-au/guide/iphone/iph3e0ca2db/26/ios/26
